description: This file defines a Scheduler class for managing prioritized request queues with caching support, including methods for adding requests, polling, peeking, and queue management, utilizing heapq and external caching mechanisms.

classes.name: SchedulerCacheKeys
classes.description: Enumeration for cache key constants related to scheduler queue and TTL.

classes.name: FlowItem
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a request item with priority, request ID, and model name.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Main class managing request queues with priority, caching, and polling functionalities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Scheduler with optional polling interval and Redis cache, setting up the cache and queue parameters.

methods.name: add_request
methods.description: Adds a new request to the queue based on its priority.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Checks if a request can be processed based on queue position and health deployment status, possibly removing it from the queue.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Checks if a request ID is at the top of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: get_queue_status
methods.description: Returns the current in-memory queue status.

methods.name: get_queue
methods.description: Retrieves the queue for a specific model from cache or in-memory.

methods.name: save_queue
methods.description: Saves the updated queue for a specific model to cache.
